original_data.title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training for Natural Language Generation, Translation, and Comprehension
original_data.raw_text: We present BART, a denoising autoencoder for conferring sequence-to-sequence models. BART is trained by (1) corrupting text with an arbitrary noise function, and (2) learning a model to reconstruct the original text.
